summary: Frontend-only e2e Playwright testing of Brandmefy landing rebuild (iteration 3 - Agenius template look). All critical visual, interaction, and integration checks pass. Sonner toast regression from iteration 2 is FIXED — '[data-sonner-toaster]' appears in DOM after submit and renders 'Thanks. Your message just landed in our inbox.' Backend /api/contact returns 200 and form clears.

issues: Overlay backdrop uses bg-black/95 (5% transparent) so hero BRANDMEFY word + stickers bleed through behind the nav links. Matches the Agenius reference but reduces legibility — consider bg-black/98 or adding a stronger backdrop-blur amount on small screens.

critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx, line 38-50: extra sticker 'Brands' (rgb(16,185,129)) was detected via .sticker selector — actually that one belongs to LogoMarquee/Brands section, not Hero. Confirmed: only 3 sticker badges in the hero (Timeless / Creative / Edgy). No issue.
Navbar.jsx body overflow lock cleanup on unmount looks correct.

App.js Toaster now imported directly from 'sonner' (fixes iteration-2 regression). Verified the rendered DOM contains <section aria-label='Notifications alt+T'> on initial load and [data-sonner-toaster] populates after first toast() call.
All interactive elements expose data-testid (menu-toggle, menu-overlay, menu-close, menu-link-*, hero-brand-word, hero-cta-primary/secondary, speak-name/email/company/message/submit).
Mobile overlay: bg-black/95 lets hero bleed through — cosmetic only, not blocking. Consider bumping to /98 or stronger backdrop-blur on <md screens for cleaner separation.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 fixed the Sonner regression by importing Toaster directly from 'sonner' in App.js (no next-themes wrapper). Backend unchanged from iteration 1. Public URL https://brandmefy-launch.preview.emergentagent.com. POST /api/contact returns {status:'sent'|'stored', message:'...'} and frontend toast shows that message via sonner. All 15 sections rendered with layered dark backgrounds. The 'Edgy' sticker uses emerald, the other two are white. Hero giant word Boldonse only — all other section headings use Anton (uppercase condensed) as specified. No em dashes anywhere.
rca of the issue: No bugs — iteration 2 Sonner regression confirmed fixed.
